description:
Return the accessibility contract for a UI component pattern — required roles, ARIA attributes, keyboard interactions, focus management, and common pitfalls — derived from the WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide.

Use this BEFORE generating a component so the produced code meets the pattern's requirements.

Args:
  - component (string): pattern name (e.g. "dialog", "tabs", "combobox").
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): default 'markdown'.

Returns (json): { component, roles, aria, keyboard: [{key, action}], focus, wcag, pitfalls }.
If the component is unknown, returns the list of available patterns.

component.description: The component pattern to describe. Available: dialog, menu button, listbox, grid, tree view, tree grid, date picker, tabs, accordion, combobox, tooltip.

name: a11y_component_guidance
title: Get accessible component guidance
